classes.name: legal entity identifier registry entry
classes.label: legal entity identifier registry entry
classes.definition: entry in a legal entity identifier registry that conforms to ISO 17442 and the Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation (GLEIF) Common Data Format (CDF)

classes.name: local operating unit

classes.definition: registrar that is authorized by the Global LEI Foundation to issue legal entity identifiers

classes.name: North American Industry Classification System code
classes.label: North American Industry Classification System code
classes.definition: the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code representing an industry

rules.qualifier: North American Industry Classification System scheme

classes.name: North American Industry Classification System scheme
classes.label: North American Industry Classification System scheme
classes.definition: the scheme defining the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Codes

rules.value: North American Industry Classification System code

classes.name: registration authority code
classes.label: registration authority code
classes.definition: identifier that uniquely identifies a business registry, and is associated with a registration authority and jurisdiction, issued by the Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation (GLEIF)

classes.name: registration status
classes.label: registration status
classes.definition: lifecycle stage indicating the status of a given registration of something, such as a business or legal entity, as specified by the registration authority

classes.name: standard industrial classification code
classes.label: standard industrial classification code
classes.definition: the SIC code representing an industry

classes.name: standard industrial classification scheme
classes.label: standard industrial classification scheme
classes.definition: the scheme defining the Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) Code List

classes.name: bank
classes.label: bank
classes.definition: depository institution, usually a corporation, that accepts deposits, makes loans, pays checks, and performs related services, for individual members of the public, businesses or other organizations

classes.name: bank holding company
classes.label: bank holding company
classes.definition: any company that owns and/or has direct or indirect control of one or more banks; BHCs may also own nonbanking subsidiaries such as broker-dealers and asset managers

classes.name: banking product
classes.label: banking product
classes.definition: product provided to consumers and businesses by a depository institution

classes.name: banking service
classes.label: banking service
classes.definition: financial service offered by a depository institution

classes.name: brokerage firm
classes.label: brokerage firm
classes.definition: firm in the business of buying and selling securities, operating as both a broker and a dealer, depending on the transaction

classes.name: business identifier code
classes.label: business identifier code
classes.definition: international identifier for financial and non-financial institutions used to facilitate automated processing of information for financial services

classes.name: business identifier code scheme
classes.label: business identifier code scheme
classes.definition: scheme that specifies the elements of a unique business identifier code (BIC) scheme to identify financial and non-financial institutions used to facilitate automated processing of information for financial services

classes.name: business party prefix
classes.label: business party prefix
classes.definition: four-character (4 alphanumeric) code associated with an organization for the purposes of banking telecommunications

classes.name: business party suffix
classes.label: business party suffix
classes.definition: two-character (2 alphanumeric) code associated with the organization for the purposes of banking telecommunications

classes.name: central bank
classes.label: central bank
classes.definition: financial institution that is the monetary authority and major regulatory bank for a country (or group of countries)

classes.name: central counterparty clearing house
classes.label: central counterparty clearing house
classes.definition: clearing house that helps facilitate trading in derivatives and equities markets

classes.name: central securities depository
classes.label: central securities depository
classes.definition: functional entity that provides a central point for depositing financial instruments ('securities'), for example, bonds and shares

classes.name: clearing bank
classes.label: clearing bank
classes.definition: commercial bank that facilitates payment and settlement of financial transactions, such as check clearing or facilitating trades between the sellers and buyers of securities or other financial instruments or contracts

classes.name: clearing corporation
classes.label: clearing corporation
classes.definition: clearing house that is organized as a corporation

classes.name: clearing house
classes.label: clearing house
classes.definition: financial service provider that is exchange affiliated and provides clearing services, including the validation, delivery, and settlement of financial transactions, for financial intermediaries

classes.name: clearing service
classes.label: clearing service
classes.definition: service provided on behalf of an institutional market participant by a clearing services provider following a trade that finalizes the transfer of security ownership

classes.name: commercial bank
classes.label: commercial bank
classes.definition: depository institution that engages in various financial services, such as accepting deposits and making loans

classes.name: commercial finance company
classes.label: commercial finance company
classes.definition: finance company that makes loans to manufacturers and wholesalers, secured by accounts receivable, inventories, and equipment

classes.name: commodity trading advisor
classes.label: commodity trading advisor
classes.definition: party that directly or indirectly advises others as to the value or advisability of buying or selling futures contracts or options

classes.name: consumer finance company
classes.label: consumer finance company
classes.definition: finance company that lends to individuals under the small loans laws of the jurisdiction in which they operate

classes.name: contractual savings institution
classes.label: contractual savings institution
classes.definition: financial institution that provides the opportunity for individuals to invest in collective investment vehicles in a fiduciary rather than a principle role

classes.name: credit union
classes.label: credit union
classes.definition: not-for-profit depository institution that makes personal loans and offers other consumer banking services, organized for the purpose of promoting thrift among its members and creating a source of credit for provident or productive purposes

classes.name: data processing service
classes.label: data processing service
classes.definition: financial service offered by an entity primarily engaged in providing infrastructure for hosting or data processing services

classes.name: data processing servicer
classes.label: data processing servicer
classes.definition: finance services provider primarily engaged in providing infrastructure for hosting or data processing services

classes.name: depository institution
classes.label: depository institution
classes.definition: any financial institution engaged in the business of receiving demand deposits from the public or other institutions

classes.name: development bank
classes.label: development bank
classes.definition: national or regional financial institution designed to provide medium- and long-term capital for productive investment, often accompanied by technical assistance, in poor countries

classes.name: electronic funds transfer service
classes.label: electronic funds transfer service
classes.definition: service involving any transfer of funds other than a transaction involving a paper instrument, that is initiated through an electronic terminal, telephone, or computer and that orders or authorizes a financial institution to debit or credit an account

classes.name: face amount certificate company
classes.label: face amount certificate company
classes.definition: investment company which is engaged or proposes to engage in the business of issuing face-amount certificates of the installment type, or which has been engaged in such business and has any such certificate outstanding

classes.name: finance company
classes.label: finance company
classes.definition: financial intermediary in the business of making loans that obtains its financing from banks, institutions, and other money market sources rather than from deposits

classes.name: financial institution
classes.label: financial institution
classes.definition: financial service provider identified as either a government agency or privately owned entity that collects funds from the public and from other institutions, and invests those funds in financial assets, such as loans, securities, bank deposits, and income-generating property

classes.name: financial service provider identifier
classes.label: financial service provider identifier
classes.definition: identifier that is officially allocated to a financial service provider based on a function that they provide, typically in a jurisdiction over which a regulatory agency has some jurisdiction

classes.name: financial service provider identifier scheme
classes.label: financial service provider identifier scheme
classes.definition: scheme that defines the financial service provider identifier per the issuing registration authority or regulatory agency

classes.name: futures commission merchant
classes.label: futures commission merchant
classes.definition: party that does both of the following: (1) solicits or accepts orders to buy or sell futures contracts, options on futures, retail off-exchange forex contracts, or swaps and (2) accepts money or other assets from customers to support such orders

classes.name: holding company
classes.label: holding company
classes.definition: business entity established to own stock in another company, typically to own enough voting shares to have some level of control over that company's policies and management

classes.name: insurance company
classes.label: insurance company
classes.definition: non-depository institution whose primary and predominant business activity is the writing of insurance or the reinsuring of risks underwritten by insurance companies, and that provides compensation based on the happening of at least one contingency

classes.name: insurance service
classes.label: insurance service
classes.definition: financial service in which the insurer promises to provide compensation for specific potential future losses in exchange for a periodic payment

classes.name: investment bank
classes.label: investment bank
classes.definition: financial service provider that acts as an underwriter or agent that serves as intermediary between the issuer of securities and the investing public

classes.name: investment company
classes.label: investment company
classes.definition: any issuer which: (a) is or holds itself out as being engaged primarily, or proposes to engage primarily, in the business of investing, reinvesting, or trading in securities; (b) is engaged or proposes to engage in the business of issuing face-amount certificates of the installment type, or has been engaged in such business and has any such certificate outstanding; or (c) is engaged or proposes to engage in the business of investing, reinvesting, owning, holding, or trading in securities, and owns or proposes to acquire investment securities having a value exceeding 40 per centum of the value of such issuer's total assets (exclusive of Government securities and cash items) on an unconsolidated basis

classes.name: investment service
classes.label: investment service
classes.definition: financial service designed to assist investors in using capital to create more money, either through income-producing vehicles or through more risk-oriented ventures to result in capital gains, including but not limited to providing investment advice, asset and portfolio management, and brokerage services

classes.name: management company
classes.label: management company
classes.definition: investment company that sells and manages a portfolio of securities other than a face-amount certificate company or unit investment fund

classes.name: merchant service
classes.label: merchant service
classes.definition: financial service provided by a financial institution to a merchant or other business, including but not limited to managing financial transactions via a secure channel

classes.name: monetary authority
classes.label: monetary authority
classes.definition: regulatory agency that controls the monetary policy, regulation and supply of money in some country or group of countries

classes.name: money services business
classes.label: money services business
classes.definition: any person doing business, whether or not on a regular basis or as an organized business concern, in one of the following capacities: (1) currency dealer or exchanger, (2) check casher, (3) issuer of traveler's checks, money orders, or stored value, (4) seller or redeemer of traveler's checks, money orders, or stored value, (5) money transmitter, or (6) postal service

classes.name: mortgage company
classes.label: mortgage company
classes.definition: financial service provider that originates and/or funds mortgages for residential or commercial property

classes.name: non-depository institution
classes.label: non-depository institution
classes.definition: financial institution that does not have a full banking license and typically is not supervised by a national or international banking regulatory agency

classes.name: payment service
classes.label: payment service
classes.definition: financial service that involves acceptance of electronic payments by a variety of payment methods including credit card, bank-based payments such as direct debit, bank transfer, and real-time bank transfer based on online banking

classes.name: payroll service
classes.label: payroll service
classes.definition: financial service, typically provided to small businesses that are not large enough to have an internal finance organization, that involves managing payment of wages to employees

classes.name: principal underwriter
classes.label: principal underwriter
classes.definition: underwriter who, as principal, purchases from an investment company, or pursuant to some contract has the right to purchase from such company, any security for distribution, or who as agent for such company sells or has the right to sell any security to a dealer or to the public, excluding any dealer who purchases from such company through sn underwriter acting as an agent for such company

classes.name: registered investment advisor
classes.label: registered investment advisor
classes.definition: registered agent and financial service provider that advises high net worth individuals on investments and manages their portfolios

classes.name: risk pooling institution
classes.label: risk pooling institution
classes.definition: financial institution that provides some financial service while spreading the financial risk inherent in that service to lower the probability of a catastrophic financial event by aggregating customers across diverse dimensions as a risk management practice

classes.name: sales finance company
classes.label: sales finance company
classes.definition: finance company that purchases retail and wholesale paper from automobile and other consumer and commercial goods dealers

classes.name: savings association
classes.label: savings association
classes.definition: depository institution that is (a) any federal savings bank or association chartered under section 1464 of the Federal Deposit Insurance Act; (b) any state chartered building and loan association, savings and loan association, or homestead association; or (c) any cooperative bank (other than a cooperative bank which is a state bank as defined in subsection (a)(2)) of the Federal Deposit Insurance Act, which is organized and operating according to the laws of the State (as defined in subsection (a)(3)) in which it is chartered or organized; and (c) any corporation (other than a bank) that the board of directors and the comptroller of the currency jointly determine to be operating in substantially the same manner as such a depository institution

classes.name: self-regulating organization
classes.label: self-regulating organization
classes.definition: non-governmental organization that has the power to create and exercise some degree of regulatory authority over an industry or profession in some country or group of countries

classes.name: trust company
classes.label: trust company
classes.definition: financial institution that acts as a fiduciary, trustee or agent of trusts and agencies

classes.name: underwriter
classes.label: underwriter
classes.definition: financial service provider that evaluates and assumes another party's risk for a fee, such as a commission, premium, spread or interest

classes.name: underwriting arrangement
classes.label: underwriting arrangement
classes.definition: written contract between parties that commits the underwriter to assuming risk

classes.name: unit investment trust
classes.label: unit investment trust
classes.definition: investment company which (a) is organized under a trust indenture, contract of custodianship or agency, or similar instrument, (b) does not have a board of directors, and (c) issues only redeemable securities, each of which represents an undivided interest in a unit of specified securities; but does not include a voting trust

classes.name: wealth management service
classes.label: wealth management service
classes.definition: financial service that combines financial and investment advice, accounting and tax services, retirement planning and legal or estate planning for one set fee

classes.name: business identifier code data record
classes.label: business identifier code data record
classes.definition: entry in a registry that conforms to ISO 9362 for the management of BIC codes and related registration information

classes.name: market identifier code registry entry
classes.label: market identifier code registry entry
classes.definition: entry in a market identifier code registry that conforms to ISO 10383

classes.name: alternative trading system
classes.label: alternative trading system
classes.definition: trading venue that is more loosely regulated than a regulated exchange

classes.name: approved publication arrangement
classes.label: approved publication arrangement
classes.definition: data reporting services provider that is authorized to provide the service of publishing certain trade reports on behalf of banks, investment firms, or asset management companies

classes.name: approved reporting mechanism
classes.label: approved reporting mechanism
classes.definition: data reporting services provider that is authorized to provide the service of reporting details of transactions to competent authorities or ESMA (the European Securities and Markets Authority) on behalf of investment firms

classes.name: auction market
classes.label: auction market
classes.definition: exchange in which buyers and sellers submit competitive bids that do not involve direct negotiations between parties, as part of an auction scheduled either on demand or on a periodic basis

classes.name: consolidated tape provider
classes.label: consolidated tape provider
classes.definition: data reporting services provider that is authorized to provide the service of collecting trade reports for financial instruments from regulated markets, MTFs, OTFs and APAs and consolidating them into a continuous electronic live data stream providing price and volume data per financial instrument

classes.name: crypto asset services provider
classes.label: crypto asset services provider
classes.definition: financial services provider that provides services for crypto assets that enable the control of crypto assets, and participate in, or provide, financial services for issuers' offers, or sale, of crypto assets

classes.name: dark pool
classes.label: dark pool
classes.definition: privately organized alternative trading system, that allows institutional investors the ability to trade without exposure until after the trade has been executed and reported

classes.name: data reporting services provider
classes.label: data reporting services provider
classes.definition: market data provider and reporting party that reports and/or publishes data on securities transactions, including required regulatory reporting for such transactions, and as such is subject to regulatory supervision

classes.name: designated contract market
classes.label: designated contract market
classes.definition: exchange, trading system, or platform that enables listing for trading futures or option contracts based on any underlying commodity, index or instrument

classes.name: electronic communication network
classes.label: electronic communication network
classes.definition: alternative trading system that automatically matches buy and sell orders for securities in the market

classes.name: exchange
classes.label: exchange
classes.definition: any organization, association, or group of persons, whether incorporated or unincorporated, which constitutes, maintains, or provides a facility for bringing together purchasers and sellers of financial instruments, commodities, or other products, services, or goods, and includes the market place and facilities maintained by such exchange

classes.name: exchange participant
classes.label: exchange participant
classes.definition: registered agent who, in accordance with the rules of an exchange, may trade on or through the exchange and whose name is entered in a list, register or roll kept by the exchange as an agent who may trade on or through the exchange

classes.name: interdealer quotation system
classes.label: interdealer quotation system
classes.definition: automated system for organizing and disseminating price quotes by brokers and dealer firms that facilitates electronic trading in securities

classes.name: market category classifier
classes.label: market category classifier
classes.definition: classifier representing the controlled vocabulary that delineates the nature of the exchange or data reporting services provider where possible

classes.name: market identifier
classes.label: market identifier
classes.definition: identifier that specifies a universal method of identifying exchanges, trading platforms, regulated or non-regulated markets, and data reporting services providers as sources of prices and related information in order to facilitate automated processing

classes.name: market indicator code status
classes.label: market indicator code status
classes.definition: lifecycle stage indicating the status of the MIC code, as specified by the registration authority

classes.name: market level classifier
classes.label: market level classifier
classes.definition: classifier that indicates whether the exchange or data reporting services provider is an operating level or market segment level facility

classes.name: market segment-level market
classes.label: market segment-level market
classes.definition: section of an exchange/market/trade reporting facility that specialises in one or more specific instruments or that is regulated differently

classes.name: market segment-level market identifier
classes.label: market segment-level market identifier
classes.definition: market identifier that identifies a section of an exchange/market/trade reporting facility that specialises in one or more specific instruments or that is regulated differently

classes.name: multilateral trading facility
classes.label: multilateral trading facility
classes.definition: trading system that facilitates the exchange of financial instruments between multiple parties

classes.name: off-market facility
classes.label: off-market facility
classes.definition: facility used for reporting over-the-counter (OTC) and other direct trades that are not executed by the exchange but are reported through the exchange

classes.name: operating-level market
classes.label: operating-level market
classes.definition: exchange/market/trade reporting facility in a specific market/country

classes.name: operating-level market identifier
classes.label: operating-level market identifier
classes.definition: market identifier that identifies an exchange/market/trade reporting facility in a specific market/country

classes.name: organised trading facility
classes.label: organised trading facility
classes.definition: multi-lateral system which is not an RM or an MTF and in which multiple third-party buying and selling interests in bonds, structured finance products, emission allowances or derivatives are able to interact in the system in a way that results in a contract in accordance with the provisions of Title II of MiFID II

classes.name: quote-driven market
classes.label: quote-driven market
classes.definition: exchange in which prices are determined from bid and ask quotations made by market makers, dealers, or specialists

classes.name: recognised market operator
classes.label: recognised market operator
classes.definition: exchange that is operated or maintained by an operator registered under certain securities regulations that brings together purchasers and sellers of capital market products

classes.name: registered multilateral trading facility
classes.label: registered multilateral trading facility
classes.definition: multilateral system operated by an investment firm or market operator, which brings together multiple third-party buying and selling interests in financial instruments in the system, in accordance with non-discretionary rules, in a way that results in a contract in accordance with the provisions of Title II of the MiFID II

classes.name: regulated exchange
classes.label: regulated exchange
classes.definition: regulated market that is operated by and/or managed by a market operator that brings together or facilitates the bringing together of multiple third-party buying and selling interests in financial instruments

classes.name: swap execution facility
classes.label: swap execution facility
classes.definition: exchange that enables participants to execute and trade swaps

classes.name: systematic internaliser
classes.label: systematic internaliser
classes.definition: investment firm that, on an organised, frequent, systematic and substantial basis, deals on its own account by executing client orders outside a regulated exchange, MTF or OTF without operating a multilateral system

classes.name: trade reporting facility
classes.label: trade reporting facility
classes.definition: facility that provides a mechanism for the reporting of transactions effected otherwise than on an exchange

classes.name: examiner
classes.label: examiner
classes.definition: party empowered as an official representative by a regulatory agency to investigate and review specified documents for accuracy and truthfulness

classes.name: government-issued license
classes.label: government-issued license
classes.definition: grant of permission needed to legally perform some task, provide some service, exercise a certain privilege, or pursue some business or occupation

classes.name: regulation identification scheme
classes.label: regulation identification scheme
classes.definition: a scheme for organizing information and allocating identifiers to regulations

classes.name: regulation identifier
classes.label: regulation identifier
classes.definition: an identifier associated with a regulation

classes.name: regulatory capacity
classes.label: regulatory capacity
classes.definition: the capacity of some natural person to regulate some industry, organization, or product by virtue of some certification program on behalf of some regulatory agency

classes.name: tax authority
classes.label: tax authority
classes.definition: regulatory agency that has jurisdiction over the assessment, determination, collection, imposition and other aspects of any tax

classes.name: CRD credit institution
classes.label: CRD credit institution
classes.definition: an undertaking whose business is to receive deposits or other repayable funds from the public and to grant credits for its own account as defined by the European Banking Authority (EBA)

classes.name: credit institution
classes.label: credit institution
classes.definition: an undertaking the business of which is to take deposits or other repayable funds from the public and to grant credits for its own account, and to which authorisation has been granted to operate within the European Union and European Economic Area countries (EEA)

classes.name: credit institution / investment firm
classes.label: credit institution / investment firm
classes.definition: classification specific to European financial institutions that designates them as credit institutions / investment firms as defined by the European Banking Authority (EBA)

classes.name: European Economic Area branch
classes.label: European Economic Area branch
classes.definition: a branch of a credit institution authorised in another European Economic Area (EEA) country that has the right to passport its activities

classes.name: investment firm
classes.label: investment firm
classes.definition: any legal person whose regular occupation or business is the provision of one or more investment services to third parties and/or the performance of one or more investment activities on a professional basis

classes.name: local firm
classes.label: local firm
classes.definition: a firm dealing for its own account on markets in financial futures or options or other derivatives and on cash markets for the sole purpose of hedging positions on derivatives markets, or dealing for the accounts of other members of those markets and being guaranteed by clearing members of the same markets, where responsibility for ensuring the performance of contracts entered into by such a firm is assumed by clearing members of the same markets

classes.name: non European Economic Area branch
classes.label: non European Economic Area branch
classes.definition: a branch of a credit institution whose Head Office is in a third country

classes.name: payment institution
classes.label: payment institution
classes.definition: a legal person that has been granted authorisation in accordance with Article 10 to provide and execute payment services throughout the European community

classes.name: Credit Institution Register entry
classes.label: Credit Institution Register entry
classes.definition: entry in the Credit Institution Register, a repository of credit institutions collected by the European Banking Authority (EBA) as provided by the various national banking authorities for those institutions that qualify

classes.name: Canadian credit union
classes.label: Canadian credit union
classes.definition: not-for-profit financial institution, typically formed by the employees of a company, labor union, or religious group, operated as a cooperative association organized for the purpose of promoting thrift among its members and creating a source of credit for provident or productive purposes

classes.name: business number
classes.label: business number
classes.definition: unique, 9-digit number that is the standard identifier for legal entities in Canada which are typically a business

rules.value: Canada Revenue Agency business number registration identifier scheme

classes.name: corporation income tax number
classes.label: corporation income tax number
classes.definition: concatenation of an entity's business number, the 'RC' abbreviation and a 4-digit subaccount number used for reporting corporate income tax

rules.value: Canada Revenue Agency corporation income tax number identifier scheme

classes.name: Goods and Services Tax / Harmonized Sales Tax registration number
classes.label: Goods and Services Tax / Harmonized Sales Tax registration number
classes.definition: concatenation of an entity's business number, the 'RT' abbreviation and a 4-digit subaccount number used for reporting GST/HST

rules.value: Canada Revenue Agency Goods and Services Tax / Harmonized Sales Tax registration number identifier scheme

classes.name: import export program number
classes.label: import export program number
classes.definition: concatenation of an entity's business number, the 'RM' abbreviation and a 4-digit subaccount number used for customs and import/export reporting purposes

rules.value: Canada Revenue Agency import export program number identifier scheme

classes.name: information return program number
classes.label: information return program number
classes.definition: concatenation of an entity's business number, the 'RZ' abbreviation and a 4-digit subaccount number used for information returns

rules.value: Canada Revenue Agency information return program number identifier scheme

classes.name: payroll deductions program number
classes.label: payroll deductions program number
classes.definition: concatenation of an entity's business number, the 'RP' abbreviation and a 4-digit subaccount number used for reporting payroll deductions

rules.value: Canada Revenue Agency payroll deductions program number registration service

classes.name: registered charity program number
classes.label: registered charity program number
classes.definition: concatenation of an entity's business number, the 'RR' abbreviation and a 4-digit subaccount number used for registered charity contribution

rules.value: Canada Revenue Agency registered charity program number identifier scheme

classes.name: agency of a foreign banking organization
classes.label: agency of a foreign banking organization
classes.definition: place of business of a foreign bank, located in any state, at which credit balances are maintained, checks are paid, money is lent, or, to the extent not prohibited by state or federal law, deposits are accepted from a person or entity that is not a citizen or resident of the United States

classes.name: agreement corporation
classes.label: agreement corporation
classes.definition: corporation chartered by a state to engage in international banking, so named because the corporation enters into an 'agreement' with the Fed's Board of Governors that it will limit its activities to those permitted

classes.name: agreement corporation - banking
classes.label: agreement corporation - banking
classes.definition: agreement corporation whose charter allows the corporation to engage in international banking

classes.name: agreement corporation - investment
classes.label: agreement corporation - investment
classes.definition: agreement corporation whose charter allows the corporation to engage in international investment banking

classes.name: bankers' bank
classes.label: bankers' bank
classes.definition: commercial bank owned exclusively (except to the extent directors' qualifying shares are required by law) by other depository institutions or depository institution holding companies, the activities of which are limited by its articles of association exclusively to providing services to or for other depository institutions, their holding companies, and the officers, directors, and employees of such institutions and companies, and to providing correspondent banking services at the request of other depository institutions or their holding companies

classes.name: bankers' bank that is not subject to reserve requirements
classes.label: bankers' bank that is not subject to reserve requirements
classes.definition: bankers' bank whose activities are not limited by specific requirements of the Federal Reserve

classes.name: bankers' bank subject to reserve requirements
classes.label: bankers' bank subject to reserve requirements
classes.definition: bankers' bank whose activities are limited by specific requirements of the Federal Reserve

classes.name: branch of a depository institution
classes.label: branch of a depository institution
classes.definition: any office or any place of business located in any State of the United States at which deposits are received

classes.name: commercial lending company
classes.label: commercial lending company
classes.definition: any institution, other than a bank or an organization operating under section 25 of the Federal Reserve Act [12 U.S.C. 601 et seq.], organized under the laws of any State of the United States, or the District of Columbia which maintains credit balances incidental to or arising out of the exercise of banking powers and engages in the business of making commercial loans

classes.name: cooperative bank
classes.label: cooperative bank
classes.definition: state-chartered savings association that is organized and operates according to the laws of the state in which it is chartered or organized, including Massachusetts, New Hampshire, Rhode Island or Vermont

classes.name: domestic branch of a foreign bank
classes.label: domestic branch of a foreign bank
classes.definition: place of business of a foreign bank, located in any state, at which deposits are received, and that is not an agency as defined in https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-12/chapter-II/subchapter-A/part-211/subpart-B/section-211.21

classes.name: domestic branch of domestic bank
classes.label: domestic branch of domestic bank
classes.definition: branch that resides in the United States, and whose parent is also located in the United States

classes.name: domestic entity
classes.label: domestic entity
classes.definition: financial service provider that is incorporated and domiciled in the United States

classes.name: domestic entity other
classes.label: domestic entity other
classes.definition: domestic institution that engages in banking activities usually in connection with the business of banking in the United States

classes.name: domestic non-bank subsidiary of a domestic entity
classes.label: domestic non-bank subsidiary of a domestic entity
classes.definition: non-bank financial service provider based in the United States of which 25 percent or more of whose voting shares are owned or controlled by an entity that is also based in the United States, or of which a majority of its directors are controlled by such domestic entity, or of which 25 percent or more of whose voting shares are held by trustees for the benefit of the shareholders or members of such domestic entity
parents: non-bank subsidiary of a domestic entity

classes.name: edge corporation
classes.label: edge corporation
classes.definition: corporation chartered by the Federal Reserve to engage in international banking and financial operations

classes.name: edge corporation - banking
classes.label: edge corporation - banking
classes.definition: edge corporation whose charter allows the corporation to engage in international banking

classes.name: edge corporation - domestic branch
classes.label: edge corporation - domestic branch
classes.definition: branch of an edge corporation that is located in the United States

classes.name: edge corporation - investment
classes.label: edge corporation - investment
classes.definition: edge corporation whose charter allows the corporation to engage in international investment banking

classes.name: farm credit system institution
classes.label: farm credit system institution
classes.definition: federally-chartered financial institution that is supervised, examined, and regulated by the Farm Credit Administration and operates in accordance with the Farm Credit Act of 1971, as amended, 12 U.S.C. 2001 et seq

classes.name: federal agency of foreign banking organization
classes.label: federal agency of foreign banking organization
classes.definition: agency of a foreign bank established and operating under section 3102 of CFR Title 12, Chapter 32 and section 4 of the International Banking Act of 1978
parents: agency of a foreign banking organization

classes.name: federal branch of foreign banking organization
classes.label: federal branch of foreign banking organization
